query:
UPDATE ai_analyses
             SET status = 'completed',
                 calories = $2, protein_grams = $3, fat_grams = $4, carbs_grams = $5,
                 fiber_grams = $6, sugar_grams = $7, sodium_mg = $8,
                 description = $9, confidence_score = $10, raw_response = $11
             WHERE id = $1
